np_calibration.operational_rule: SUPPRESS iff SQRT alarm AND Router V2 UP AND selected-expert Wilson-LCB > tau

calibration_2024_sqrt.note: Calibration diagnostic only; not independent validation.

interpretation: The NP order-statistic calibration produced tau=0.430266 with the intended alpha=0.20 / delta=0.10 safety target.
The calibrated threshold was below every frozen Router V2 UP score that intersected SQRT alarms in 2024 and 2025.
Therefore NP V1 reproduces the existing hard Router-V2 veto exactly on the SQRT alarm subset.
It adds a formal asymmetric-risk calibration interpretation but does not improve suppression selectivity, false-alarm removal, or true-DOWN preservation.
The 2025 actual-DOWN suppression rate on the full daily panel was 10.31%, and on SQRT alarm actual-DOWN cases was 13.33%, both below alpha=20% descriptively.
Because the operational action set is unchanged, NP V1 is not an incremental dampener improvement.
decision.next_step: Move to the second cross-domain method: a preregistered selective three-action RETAIN/WATCH/SUPPRESS controller, while keeping Router V2 frozen.
